shortDescription: Kiara Reserve Residences is a branded beachfront condominium by Minor International at Layan Beach in Phuket, adjacent to the Anantara Layan resort and managed with Anantara.
description: Kiara Reserve Residences is a branded beachfront condominium by Minor International at Layan Beach in Phuket, adjacent to the Anantara Layan resort and managed with Anantara. The condominium building has 5 floors and 25 units in three- and four-bedroom layouts, including duplexes and penthouses. Built-up areas run from about 251 sqm upward, with owners able to join a rental programme.

researchNotes: Project has two products: a condominium (25 units, used here) and villas (17 per EdgeProp, sold separately); supplied name 'Residences' matches the condominium listing. Developer: Minor International; EdgeProp also names Kajima Corporation as partner. Ownership conflict: Keller Henson says freehold (foreign quota 49%) but also mentions 'lease registration' and Papaya reportedly lists leasehold - verify with lawyer. Papaya page was 404. Completion dates conflict (2025/Dec 2025/2026 Q1). Unit count 25 here vs 29 in another source. Address (Layan Beach Soi 4 per a Sotheby's listing) not verified. Distances unspecified mode. | Keller Henson: 3BR typical THB 44.5M, 3BR duplex 67.5M, range up to 115.5M. Separate villa product (Keller Henson villa page) is listed from about THB 75M and is not included.
